ns2:course.label: Seminar in Medieval Studies
ns2:course.description: Team-taught, interdisciplinary seminar on varying topics in Medieval Studies drawing on faculty from UIUC and invited scholars from other universities. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. Approved for both letter and S/U grading.
